The '''Founding Day''' of the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]],<ref name="Wild Space" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] family of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] descended from "[[The First Organa]]"<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and ancestors who were among the first to settle Alderaan and were pivotal in the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Organa Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|House Organa}}</ref> in [[25,053 BBY]],<ref name="TORE" /> was celebrated with [[Fireworks/Legends|fireworks]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Alderaan's [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to the [[Monarch of Alderaan|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] of Alderaan, compared the fireworks of Founding Day with the pain in his shoulders as he carried the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during their [[Mission to Zigoola|mission]] to the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] planet [[Zigoola]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Wild Space" />

==Behind the scenes==
Founding Day was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a [[2008]] novel by [[Karen Miller]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
